d.tr: So I will ping you on WhatsApp
d.ctx: The user and expert are discussing meeting up and the user suggests moving the conversation to WhatsApp. The expert agrees.
d.j: The user proposes moving the conversation to an external app (WhatsApp).

d.ctx: The user begins dictating their phone number to the expert. The expert listens and confirms.
d.j: The user is providing their phone number to the expert to facilitate contact outside the app.
